piezas.titulo: Speaking practice: Numbers, age and basic details
texto: Speaking practice with numbers and age: in a friendly conversation between young people, the usual question about age is «คุณอายุเท่าไหร่ครับ/คะ» (How old are you?). The direct answer follows the pattern [อายุ + number + ปี]. In spoken dialogue it is common to smile and keep a friendly tone. Practise saying the tones of numbers smoothly, without hesitating.
